} ``` **Route Handlers** (for API endpoints): - Located in `/app/api/*/route.ts` - Support GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS - Use NextRequest/NextResponse objects **Directives**: - `'use server'` - Mark function/file as server-only - `'use client'` - Mark function/file as client-only - `'use cache'` - Enable component caching (with `cacheComponents: true`) **Caching Strategies**: - Static rendering by default (built at build time) - Dynamic rendering (when Dynamic APIs detected) - Data Cache (persistent, revalidatable) - Request Cache (within single render pass) ### 9. **Current Implementation Status** **Implemented**: - Root layout with metadata - Home page with server-side data fetching example - ProductList component (presentation component) - Project setup with TypeScript and dependencies **TODO/Not Yet Implemented**: - UserProfile component (marked with TODO comment) - API routes (/api/products, /api/users/profile) - Server Actions for mutations - Client-side interactive components - Error handling and loading states ### 10. **Development Scripts** Available npm scripts: - `npm run dev` - Start development server - `npm run build` - Build for production - `npm run start` - Start production server --- This is a modern Next.js 16 application using the App Router with React 19, set up for full-stack development with server-side rendering, data fetching, and API routes. - Renders the user's name and email

- Async server component (like `Page` in `page.tsx`)
- Interface for type safety (like `Product` in `ProductList.tsx`)

- Simple `<div>` markup with an `<h2>` heading (like `ProductList`)
